laneSeparation.rule: Native BLiMP is reported as its own evidence lane. Native and prompted scores are never averaged, and a ranking flip between them is reported as a protocol-sensitivity diagnostic.

harness.pinnedCommitSubject: fix(basqueglue): load the f1 metric with evaluate (#4076)
harness.install: git clone https://github.com/EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness.git && git -C lm-evaluation-harness checkout d6de81643928d653435c431bae19945d41d32520
harness.note: Never run whatever lm-eval happens to be installed globally. The checkout must be at pinnedCommit and its files must match pinnedFileSha256.
harness.treeHashConvention: subtaskTreeSha256 is sha256 over the concatenation, for every non-underscore *.yaml in lm_eval/tasks/blimp/ sorted by ascending byte order of filename, of:  NUL <lowercase sha256 hex of that file's bytes> LF.

groupAggregate.recomputationRule: Plain unweighted arithmetic mean of the 67 per-subtask acc values. Implemented in validate_native_blimp.py as an independent cross-check of the harness-reported groups.blimp.acc.

task.datasetRevisionNote: The pinned harness BLiMP YAML carries no dataset revision key, so upstream resolves nyu-mll/blimp at whatever main points to. This lane therefore binds the dataset revision out-of-band and requires the resolved revision to equal datasetPinnedRevision; otherwise promotion is blocked with dataset_revision_mismatch.
task.licenseNote: BLiMP is CC-BY-4.0. Preserve attribution when redistributing sample logs.

vllm.loglikelihoodMechanism: SamplingParams(temperature=0, prompt_logprobs=1, max_tokens=1, detokenize=False) in _model_generate; _loglikelihood_tokens sums outputs.prompt_logprobs over the continuation span and derives is_greedy from the per-position argmax.
vllm.oneOfRequiredNote: Exactly one of max_model_len or max_length must be explicit. The pinned backend forbids both together and, when neither is given, resolves the context length from the model config, which would leave the no-hidden-truncation guarantee unbound.
vllm.chatTemplateNote: The backend implements apply_chat_template but it is only wired in when --apply_chat_template is passed. This lane forbids that flag outright so an instruction-tuned checkpoint cannot silently be scored through its chat format.

truncation.warningText: Context length %s exceeds max length (%s). Truncating context.
truncation.gap: The harness only logs this warning; it does not mark the affected document. This lane treats any occurrence of that warning in run output as a hard protocol failure.

gguf.loglikelihoodMechanism: Exact teacher forcing, one HTTP request per continuation token. The target token is forced with logit_bias=[[target_id, 100]] and the pre-sampling logprob is read back from choices[0].logprobs.content[0]; is_greedy comes from the top_logprobs argmax.
gguf.ignoredModelArgsNote: gguf.py accepts max_length and stores it but never reads it. Passing it would look like a context control while changing nothing, so this lane records it and forbids it from the frozen model_args.
serverRequirements: POST /tokenize accepts {content, add_special} and returns tokens[].
POST /v1/completions accepts prompt as a token-id array, logprobs=2, and logit_bias as a list of [token_id, bias] pairs (llama.cpp extension, not the OpenAI map form).
POST /v1/completions returns choices[0].logprobs.content[] entries carrying id, logprob and top_logprobs.
The server must sample the forced token id; a different sampled id is a protocol failure, not a low score.
gguf.chatTemplateNote: The gguf backend never calls apply_chat_template. The completion route is used directly with raw prompt text / token ids.

llamaCpp.minimumServerCapability: logprobs.content in the modern OpenAI shape

introducedBy.title: server : fix logprobs, make it OAI-compatible

gguf.chatOnlyServerNote: A chat-completions-only server cannot satisfy this backend: there is no /tokenize, /v1/chat/completions is not used, and gguf.py raises rather than degrading when logprobs are absent. Such a runtime is marked protocol_unavailable, never scored through prompted accuracy.

unsupportedBackends.reason: Parses the legacy token_logprobs/text_offset echo schema that modern llama-server no longer returns, so it cannot evaluate a current llama-server either.

adaptationPolicy.likelihoodNormalization: summed over the continuation span, never length-normalized; acc comes from the is_greedy/argmax decision defined by the pinned harness task implementation
adaptationPolicy.bosHandling: vLLM: add_bos_token model arg, recorded and must be explicit in the frozen config. GGUF: /tokenize is always called with add_special=True and the backend exposes no way to change it, so BOS is always on for the GGUF lane.
adaptationPolicy.eosHandling: EOS is never appended to a scored continuation; the gguf backend uses EOS only as a generation stop string.
adaptationPolicy.leadingSpaceConvention: Trailing whitespace on the context is migrated onto the continuation, matching the HF and GGUF backends.
adaptationPolicy.normalizationRuleSource: Follow the pinned harness implementation. This lane introduces no Pari-specific normalization rule.

reasons.--apply_chat_template: chat-template drift; would make an instruction-tuned checkpoint score through its chat format and stop being native BLiMP
reasons.--limit: a limited run is debug-only and can never become full native evidence
reasons.--samples: an explicit document subset is debug-only
reasons.--gen_kwargs: generative overrides have no meaning on a loglikelihood lane and can smuggle decoding state in
reasons.--system_instruction: prompt adaptation outside the native protocol
reasons.--predict_only: skips metric computation, so no accuracy is produced
reasons.--include_path: would let an on-disk task directory shadow the pinned blimp task definitions
reasons.--num_fewshot: BLiMP is pinned to num_fewshot 0; any value is a protocol change

promotionGates.rule: The harness checkout is at pinnedCommit and every pinnedFileSha256 matches.
Subtask coverage is exactly the 67 pinned names, each with n-samples.original == 1000 and effective == 1000.
The resolved nyu-mll/blimp revision equals datasetPinnedRevision.
No --limit, no --samples, and no reduced effective sample count anywhere.
No chat template was applied and enable_thinking is not set.
The backend returned usable logprobs for every scored position; the run log contains no missing-logprobs or forced-token-mismatch error.
The run log contains no harness truncation warning.
The harness process exited zero and recorded zero runtime errors. A genuinely low accuracy is a score; only a failed run is a failure, and the two are never conflated.
The harness-reported group acc independently reproduces as the unweighted mean of the 67 per-subtask acc values.
Model revision, tokenizer revision, quantization, dtype, TP size, max context, seed, backend version/commit and harness output hashes are all recorded.

qualification.oneNotebookRequirement: Before this lane is attached to the multi-notebook Kaggle roster, it must be qualified end-to-end on exactly one T4 notebook per backend. Promotion evidence requires a real full 67-subtask run on Kaggle T4 hardware for at least one vLLM finalist and one GGUF/llama.cpp finalist, each with a complete receipt. A second notebook is not a substitute for fixing a failing first notebook.
qualification.smokeNotPromotable: A --limit smoke run may prove that the lane executes and that logprobs are usable. It is never promotion evidence and its receipt is stamped promotable=false.
